_comment: Gzipped production-bundle size budgets in KB. `npm run budget` (and CI) fails if any is exceeded. These guard first-load weight for indigent patients on slow connections. When a change legitimately grows a bundle, bump the relevant number here in the same PR and say why — that keeps growth a deliberate, reviewed decision instead of silent drift. Headroom over the 2026-09-29 baseline is ~10-15%. 2026-11-14: totalJs 1050 -> 1060 for multi-hospital Phase 6 (the lazy platform-admin Hospitals page, ~5 KB gz, loaded only by the network operator; initial/index unchanged within budget). 2026-11-14: totalJs 1060 -> 1075 for multi-hospital Phases 7-8 (partner pickers, Hospital Settings page, case-hospital branding; lazy staff chunks — the patient boot path stays ~386 KB of 410). 2026-11-14: chunk index 185 -> 188 for the multi-hospital page restructure (the shared shell gained the user's hospital name, the platform admin's sidebar + onboarding badge, and partner-filtered promotions — every role loads it; initial JS ~387 of 410). 2026-11-14: totalJs 1075 -> 1085, chunk index 188 -> 190 for complete hospital onboarding (partner picker + setup checklist on the platform console, Hospital Admin getting-started card, onboarding notifications) — measured 1074.5 / 187.9 with demo-panel flags off, i.e. no headroom left; initial JS ~390 of 410. Note: a local build with VITE_SHOW_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=true also bundles the dev demo panel, so measure budgets with it off. 2026-11-14: totalJs 1085 -> 1090 for the lifecycle-consistency fixes (reject/close cascades to open slices, bill correction, endorse confirmation, slot helper) — lazy staff chunks only; measured 1085.9; initial JS unchanged (~392 of 410).
